description: Search investments (developer projects, primary market). Two modes: with city (full data) or with name alone (whole Poland; only investment_slug, name and offers_active, in the site's order). Use it when the question is about projects rather than single flats: e.g. the cheapest per m² in a city, the investments of one developer (city + developer_slug from deweloperuch_search_developers), the slug of an investment by its name. With city it returns the investments the site shows on the city's map (those with active offers; ones without may be missing) with averages over active offers; name and developer_slug narrow the list, sort orders it (default: most active offers; entries without an average come last). Offers and details of one investment come from deweloperuch_get_investment (investment_slug); a particular offer's price history from deweloperuch_get_offer. No price or area filter here — for those ranges use deweloperuch_get_market_statistics. city=polska does not work. These are developers' asking prices. Two kinds of prices must not be mixed: developers' asking prices (deweloperuch_search_investments, deweloperuch_get_investment, deweloperuch_get_offer, deweloperuch_get_market_statistics), RCN transaction prices (deweloperuch_estimate_property_value, deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics, deweloperuch_rank_locations, deweloperuch_get_building) — what flats actually sold for, from the Real Estate Price Register. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Fields ending in _url are pages of deweloperuch.pl: give them to the user as links. Result shape: { total: number | null (null when the site does not say — a search by name), returned, truncated, hint?, source, items: [with city: { investment_slug, name, city_slug?, district?, street?, status? ('active' | 'archived'), offers_active?, offers_total?, avg_price?, avg_area_m2?, avg_price_per_m2? (active offers only, as the site counts them), developer_slug?, developer_name?, investment_url?, developer_url? } | by name: { investment_slug, name, offers_active? }] } — the list key is `items`.

city.description: city_slug of one city from deweloperuch_search_locations, e.g. warszawa, sopot (not polska).

developer_slug.description: developer_slug from deweloperuch_search_developers or from results of the investment tools, e.g. atal. Only with city.

limit.description: Most investments in the result, 1–30, default 10 (about 550–750 characters each with links).

name.description: Fragment of an investment name, 2–100 characters, e.g. Kolibki. With city, case and Polish characters do not matter; without city the site searches the whole country.

sort.description: Only with city. active_offers (default): most active offers; price_per_m2_asc / price_per_m2_desc: average price per m²; price_asc / price_desc: average price; name: alphabetical. Entries without an average come last.

name: deweloperuch_search_investments
title: Search investments
